preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the permutation n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= q[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array q must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the lexicographically minimal permutation.
The output must contain the lexicographically maximal permutation.
